info.name: Get token balances for an address

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bsc'). If omitted, returns balances across all supported chains.

params.name: address
params.description: The blockchain address to query balances for.

items.docs: Returns token balances for the specified address, optionally filtered by chains.

info.name: Get token balances for an entity

params.name: cheap
params.description: If 'true', uses a faster but less real-time balance query (up to 24 hours delayed).

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bsc'). If omitted, returns balances across all supported chains.

params.name: entity
params.description: The entity ID to query balances for.

items.docs: Returns token balances for the specified entity, optionally filtered by chains.

info.name: Get Solana subaccount balances for addresses

params.name: pricingID
params.description: The CoinGecko pricing ID of the token to query subaccount balances for. Filters results to balances of this token.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of subaccount balance entries to return. Default: 1000.

params.name: addresses
params.description: Comma-separated list of Solana addresses to query subaccount balances for.

items.docs: Returns token balances from Solana subaccounts (staking, lending, etc.) for the specified addresses.

info.name: Get Solana subaccount balances for entities

params.name: pricingID
params.description: The CoinGecko pricing ID of the token to query subaccount balances for. Filters results to balances of this token.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of subaccount balance entries to return. Default: 1000.

params.name: entities
params.description: Comma-separated list of entity IDs to query subaccount balances for.

items.docs: Returns token balances from Solana subaccounts (staking, lending, etc.) for the specified entities.
